Pick an option from an EC autocomplete dropdown (…:dd) by its exact item label: click the chevron, wait for the option row (tr[data-item-label]) and click it. A pending form re-render (e.g. after a date Tab-out) can close the panel between open and click, so one re-open retry is built in. Typing into autocomplete-dd fields is unreliable.

Select an autocomplete-dropdown option found by its LABEL in ${form} (no hardcoded ids). Targets the dd input SPECIFICALLY (contains 'dd_input') - the generic //input matches TWO nodes for a dropdown (dd_input + dd_hinput) and trips Browser strict mode. Derives the PrimeFaces widget prefix (strip '_input' -> '...:dd'), then reuses Select EC Dropdown Option (chevron -> item row).
